profile_text.body:
Elicit is an AI research assistant focused on scientific literature. The company describes its tool as enabling users to search, summarize, extract data from, and chat with a corpus of over 125 million papers. According to the company's site, Elicit is used by over 2 million researchers in academia and industry, and it emphasizes the ability to deeply customize its generated reports, including which papers are covered and what information is included.

The held facts classify Elicit's product under search, research, translation, and related categories, noting its use cases in paper analysis, systematic review, and academic integrity. Elicit also appears in the MCP registry with two servers: one called ai.elicitly/elicitly, described as providing human-in-the-loop functionality for AI agents via MCP elicitation with confirm and form dialogs plus a capability doctor, and one called ai.elicitly/pro, described as offering durable approvals with a hosted review page and audit trail. No litigation or securities filings are present in the available data.
